query: insert into ontology.vector_index_definition (type_name, name, property_name, metric, index_kind, nlist, m, ef_construction) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) on conflict (type_name, name) do update set property_name = excluded.property_name, metric = excluded.metric, index_kind = excluded.index_kind, nlist = excluded.nlist, m = excluded.m, ef_construction = excluded.ef_construction
